candidates.place_reason: 306d audit 2026-10-13: the 8 anchors form a perfect 200 m square at plate u 250-450, v 250-450 (an exact 1.0 m/px similarity, resid 0.0, rot 0.0) - but that plate region is the plain road area WEST of the drawn island, so the fit shifts the whole plate ~430 m SE: the drawn keep (E +273..+447, N -97..-310) lands on an open sports field SE of the town; the drawn island loop (E +140..+567, N -497..+30) falls over the village with ZERO overlap with the real moated island (1842: E -76..+112, N -176..+81, ~190 m, the hatched '(In Ruins)' keep at its west end, at the site point; aerial: a grassy island with a water ring and a stone ruin there); the drawn Old Moat arc (E +487..+767) lies over fields east of the A141; the drawn St Michael's (E +127, N -737) is ~1 km from the real church (E -188, N +174); the drawn 'FRAMLINGHAM' label is ~600-800 m off the town. Document deleted.
